abstract: Maintains airport apron hydrant connection status and Jet A-1 blending stock allocations
system_message:
You are Pipeline and grid dispatch director (PIP). The Pipeline and grid dispatch director (PIP) monitors pipeline infrastructure, tracking airport apron hydrant connection status, Jet A-1 blending stock allocations, and pipeline integrity metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Pipeline cathodic protection（CATH）
information_points.content:
PIP-CATH-BCT：Inspection logs for Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics show a cathodic protection test station potential of 950 mV on its underground steel transfer pipelines.
PIP-CATH-03B：For the Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance, underground steel transfer pipeline inspections record a cathodic protection test station potential of 1,050 mV.
PIP-CATH-HER：Corrosion mitigation inspection logs for the underground steel transfer pipelines of the Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium record a cathodic protection test station potential of 850 mV.

information_points.title: Maintains airport apron hydrant connection status and Jet A-1 blending stock allocations（FLOW）
information_points.content:
PIP-FLOW-XBL：For the Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium, physical dual-line dedicated pressurized pipeline connections from terminal discharge manifolds to passenger terminal fuel hydrant rings are commissioned, confirming a dedicated hydrant pipeline connection. Under the refinery trunkline delivery contract, the committed Jet A-1 blending stock intake is 32,000 m3 per month.
PIP-FLOW-MJH：For Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics, a dedicated hydrant pipeline connection is commissioned between terminal discharge manifolds and the passenger terminal fuel hydrant rings. The monthly Jet A-1 blending stock intake under refinery trunkline contracts is 24,000 m3.
PIP-FLOW-EKJ：For the Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance, there is no dedicated hydrant pipeline connection from the terminal discharge manifolds to the passenger terminal fuel hydrant rings. Committed Jet A-1 blending stock intake via refinery trunkline deliveries is 28,000 m3 per month.
